channel.title: mint - news
channel.description: Get the latest news and analysis on business, finance, politics from mint, the website of the Mint newspaper, one of India's leading business and financial dailies

item.title: Southern California Fire Burns Structures as Winds Intensify
item.description: A fast-moving wildfire in Orange County burned structures and forced evacuations Friday as powerful Santa Ana winds fueled a growing outbreak of fires across Southern California.

item.title: Tiranga march in Delhi: CJP chief Abhijeet Dipke’s whereabouts unknown, Neha Bora located at RK Puram police station
item.description: The detentions took place ahead of the ‘Lehra Do Tiranga’ protests called by the CJP against Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar over alleged irregularities in electoral rolls and voter lists.

item.title: Malibu Fire Has Crews Racing Dryness, Fierce Santa Ana Winds
item.description: At least one firefighter has been injured and hundreds more are scrambling to contain a Malibu wildfire before dangerous winds ramp up again Friday.

item.title: Meet the 17-year-old scientist engineering tomatoes to taste like meat, and why her experiment could matter
item.description: Gabriella Rothberg, a 17-year-old student from Miami, is developing genetically engineered tomatoes designed to produce heme, a molecule associated with meat flavour. Her project could have nutritional applications, but its taste and health benefits remain unproven.

item.title: Pakistan gets 2027 chairmanship of IMF, World Bank boards after 74 years, calls appointment ‘historic milestone’
item.description: Pakistan will chair the boards of governors of the IMF and World Bank Group in 2027, returning to the role after more than 70 years. The appointment was announced at the 2026 annual meetings in Bangkok.

item.title: Pope Leo XIV celebrates Mass in hospital in first photos released since surgery
item.description: The Vatican on Friday released the first picture of Pope Leo XIV following his surgery, as the Pontiff attended Mass at Rome's Gemelli Hospital and doctors reported a steady improvement in his overall health condition.

item.title: Meet Subhas Chandra Lal Das: Ex-IAS officer and former secretary of MSME ministry takes charge as DERC chairman
item.description: Retired 1992-batch IAS officer Subhas Chandra Lal Das has taken oath as chairman of the Delhi Electricity Regulatory Commission. Here’s a look at his education, administrative career and the regulator’s role in Delhi’s power sector.

item.title: Katie Zacharia ‘let go’ as White House Press Secretary after Trump urges her 'to reconsider job' amid lawyer claims row
item.description: “I said, ‘Katie, is this for you?’” Trump told reporters as he left the White House for Georgia. “I said, ‘Katie, you don't have to do this’.... I said to her, ‘Honestly, if I were you, I'd reconsider.’”

item.title: Display press IDs, avoid confrontations: PCI issues guidelines for journalists covering protests after Delhi detentions
item.description: The Press Council of India issued guidelines for journalists covering protests, urging them to prioritise safety, carry identification and more. This comes after detention of journalists on October 11 during a CJP protest against CEC Gyanesh Kumar.

item.title: Zoho’s Sridhar Vembu calls SaaS layoffs ‘normal’, bets on reinvention by 2030
item.description: Zoho founder Sridhar Vembu says layoffs are common in the SaaS industry, but the company is trying to avoid mass job cuts by retraining employees and redeploying them as AI reshapes productivity and raises data centre and computing costs.

item.title: LK Advani hospitalised in Delhi, undergoing treatment for chest infection; condition stable
item.description: The 98-year-old leader is undergoing treatment and his condition is stable, the reports said. He was brought to the hospital at around 7.30 pm and admitted to the pulmonary department, where a team of doctors is monitoring his condition.

item.title: Finance ministry appoints Subhas Chandra Lal Das as part-time chairperson FSIB
item.description: Former IAS officer to lead the bureau for three years, along side six members tasked with matters concerning public sector banks, financial institutions and insurers.

item.title: Maha FDA cancels 25 food outlet licences including Domino’s, 10 FIRs filed, ₹1.73 cr food stock seized, says Mundhe
item.description: Maharashtra FDA suspends licences of 25 food joints, seized ₹1.73 crore food stock during a statewide crackdown.

item.title: 2020 Delhi riots case: Tahir Hussain gets 2 years in jail for allowing mob to use his house to attack public
item.description: Special Public Prosecutor submitted that Tahir Hussain, an elected representative at the time, had a responsibility to maintain peace but instead facilitated the riots by allowing rioters to use his house to attack the public.

item.title: Gulshan Kumar murder to 1993 Mumbai bomb blasts, top 5 cases handled by Ujjwal Nikam other than Kasab trial
item.description: Rajkummar Rao's film Prahaar on Ujjwal Nikam's high profile trial of Ajmal Kasab was released on Friday. Check out Nikam's other popular cases.

item.title: SP vs BJP: Who will win UP elections 2027? Yogi Adityanath as CM again or Akhilesh Yadav will get chair? Survey is out
item.description: A News18 survey of 30,925 people across Uttar Pradesh found the BJP-led NDA leading the SP-Congress alliance ahead of the 2027 Assembly elections. Yogi Adityanath was the preferred chief minister, while respondents praised law and order and infrastructure but identified employment as a key concern.

item.title: FBI's Most Wanted Indian-origin $600,000 SNAP fraud case suspect Manjit Singh brought back to US after arrest in Punjab
item.description: In a post on X, Patel described Bedi as one of the FBI’s Most Wanted Fraudsters and said his return marked another success for the programme, launched three months ago.

item.title: AI makes coding faster, but is it making IT jobs harder? 7-year tech veteran's post sparks debate
item.description: A seven-year IT veteran's Reddit post about work anxiety, relentless upskilling and AI-driven expectations has sparked debate. While some workers relate to his exhaustion, others suggest switching roles, teaching or finding a healthier workplace.

item.title: Trump orders White House probe into alleged missing $5.6 million Kennedy Center donation - Report
item.description: For now, the central questions remain unresolved: whether a $5.6 million donation was actually arranged, whether the money was transferred as alleged and whether any funds intended for the Kennedy Center went missing.

item.title: ₹5,000 spent on tickets, leave denied: What are employees' rights when companies put them on a PIP?
item.description: A PIP is a formal document that an employer gives an employee to address performance concerns and set clear targets to be met within a specific period, usually 30 to 90 days.

item.title: Asked for Diwali sweets, got flooded with costly COD orders: How influencer's viral post turned into delivery nightmare
item.description: A Madurai content creator left his home after followers used his address to send unsolicited cash-on-delivery orders, including expensive appliances and food. The deliveries continued despite his plea to stop, and his whereabouts are now unclear.

item.title: ₹1.3 lakh shopping in Japan, no receipts: Traveller's customs dilemma raises a question for Indians
item.description: An Indian traveller sparked a debate over India's customs rules on goods purchased abroad after throwing away money receipts. Here's what you need to know about the duty-free allowance and what items are qualified under the revised law.

item.title: Why running up ₹35 lakh in unpaid challans makes business sense: The perverse unit economics of India’s trucking mafia
item.description: A Gurugram truck with 242 pending challans worth ₹35.43 lakh exposes gaps in overloading enforcement. Why freight competition, accumulated penalties and cross-state enforcement challenges raise questions about whether India’s trucking rules are strong enough to deter repeat violations.

item.title: ‘UK is no longer safe for us Indians’: Finfluencer flags racism abroad, urges parents to rethink overseas plans
item.description: Neha Nagar has urged Indian parents to assess the challenges their children could face before moving abroad for education or work. Her post citing alleged anti-Indian incidents in the UK and other countries has drawn mixed reactions online.

item.title: India-Canada trade deal: What New Delhi wants, what Ottawa is seeking as CEPA talks gather pace
item.description: The two countries launched formal negotiations after Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney’s visit to India in February-March 2026. Both sides have committed to concluding the talks by the end of 2026.

item.title: Rajasthan BJP chief Madan Rathore's 'we will stand with Pak' in case of war with US remark sparks Cong, AAP backlash
item.description: Rajasthan BJP chief Madan Rathore has faced criticism from Congress and AAP after saying India would stand with Pakistan in a hypothetical war with the US. He later said his remarks had been taken out of context and referred to cricket, not war.

item.title: ₹2.33 lakh hospital bill despite alleged service failures: What rights do patients' have?
item.description: A Reddit user has alleged poor facilities, delayed medical attention and a disputed ₹2.33 lakh bill at Manipal Hospital in Bengaluru. Here’s what India’s Patients’ Rights Charter says about transparent billing, medical records, emergency care and grievance redressal.

item.title: Freedom Rice Bran Oil under scrutiny: Why FSSAI issued notices to BigBasket, Flipkart
item.description: The food regulator said claims that Freedom Cooking Rice Bran Oil reduces bad cholesterol and maintains or increases good cholesterol were not permitted under applicable advertising and claims regulations. Gemini Edibles &amp; Fats India was also flagged over an alleged e-commerce licensing issue.

item.title: Want Green Card? US Court orders reopening of 2027 lottery for 55,000 applicants
item.description: Judge Ohta directed the State Department to publicly announce the registration dates, the website where applicants can submit their entries, and the eligibility requirements for participating in the lottery.

item.title: Centre amends Census rules, expands eligibility for appointment as enumerator
item.description: The Central government on Friday amended the Census Rules, 1990, expanding the categories of people eligible to perform duties as enumerators to include teachers from government and private educational institutions, government officials and clerks, among others.

item.title: Abhijeet Dipke, Neha Bora detained ahead of 'Lehra Do Tiranga' protest against CEC Gyanesh Kumar in Delhi
item.description: Abhijeet Dipke has been placed under preventive detention by Delhi Police, just minutes before the CJP proposed the ‘Lehra Do Tiranga’ protest. The event was scheduled to take place in Central Park at Connaught Place at 5 PM.

item.title: Talaq-e-Hasan row: Supreme Court seeks Centre's response on plea challenging Muslim divorce practices
item.description: The Supreme Court has sought the Centre's response on a plea to frame guidelines governing all forms of 'talaq'.

item.title: Trump's US investment tracker: India ranks 6th with $500 billion, UAE leads with $1.4 trillion; who else made the list?
item.description: The White House says Trump administration secured $11.3 trillion in investments, including $5.77 trillion through nine country-level and trade agreements. India ranked sixth with $500 billion, while a listed $300 billion Reliance partnership aims to build the first major US oil refinery in 50 years.

item.title: ‘Greatest thing I’ve ever seen’; ‘alien technology’: Internet reacts as Musk shows demo of Tesla flying car Roadster
item.description: Elon Musk’s redesigned Tesla Roadster has sparked viral reactions after a demonstration showed the electric sports car performing aerial manoeuvres using rocket-style thrusters. Social media users called it ‘alien technology’ as Tesla announced a 2028 production timeline.

item.title: Delhi Police urge Abhijeet Dipke to cancel Connaught Place march in tense livestream, cite restrictions | Watch
item.description: Delhi Police plans to block entry to Central Park in Connaught Place ahead of Cockroach Janta Party founder Abhijeet Dipke’s proposed ‘Lehra Do Tiranga’ march, citing prohibitory orders under Section 163 of the BNSS.&nbsp;
